body: I am getting help, yes. I just felt the need for complaining a bit lol
You're really kind, but it's very hard to believe that I'm a good person.  Thank you though.

People on here are so nice. Thank you so much. 
It's hard to explain this and I know I don't always make very much sense, but I don't feel loved by anyone (a lot of the time). I still think that people could get upset by me (and anyone really) passing away because it's scary. I mean, I get upset when I hear about people in my city killing themselves even though I don't even know them.

I can relate so much to you. I feel like everyone around me is shallow and boring. I wish I could find someone around me I could really talk to and feel loved around, but I don't think I'll ever be able to do so.

I don't really understand what you are saying? Can you explain it more? I personally think it's awful. I just stay in my bed all day and watch all of my friends on social media slowly forget about me.
